subject: Request: deeper technical walkthrough

Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: deeper technical walkthrough

Hi Nikhil / Camila,

I signed up and spent some time with the quickstart docs and the sandbox — really impressive. We're evaluating inference options for a new feature (very developer-focused: low-latency multi-tenant embeddings + per-customer model pinning). Our engineering manager (Maya) would like a short, focused technical walkthrough to validate the integration approach.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call next week? We're PST-based and prefer afternoons (2–5pm). I attached a small set of logs and a sample prompt file from our trial (quickstart-logs.zip).

Rough goals for the call:
- Confirm compatibility with our multitenant routing and KV cache expectations
- Discuss typical latency at 2–4k tokens under warm cache
- Ask about metrics/tracing hooks and rollout best practices

Thanks — happy to send a calendar invite once you propose a few slots.

Best,
Ethan Cole
Senior Platform Engineer, BuildAtlas
ethan@buildatlas.io

- Tue 9/14, 2:30–3:00pm PST
- Wed 9/15, 3:30–4:00pm PST

If neither works, you can pick a slot on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/nikhil/30min

Tentative agenda (can adjust):
1) 5m intros + scope
2) 15m walkthrough: trial artifacts, KV cache, routing options
3) 10m Q&A and next steps (MAP + follow-up eval)

I attached a quick mutual action plan template we often use so we can map owners post-call (mutual_action_plan.xlsx). If Maya wants to be on the call, she’s absolutely welcome; if not, we can do a separate sync with engineering.

Tell me which slot you prefer and who will be on your side.

Cheers,
